decisions.reason: The consumer drink mix builds on the firm's established nutrient line, but it sits furthest from its core engineering and R&D knowledge in waste-to-value plants, so it is the most likely candidate for pruning; its own page in 2019 still tips the decision to keep.
Modular plant extensions draw directly on the firm's in-house engineering, automation and prototyping, so it can interpret results and improve them, which favours keeping them.

WASTX Oil is a flagship decentralized waste-to-energy technology with a dedicated page and a launch press release, and the firm's R&D and university cooperation give it strong capacity to develop it further.
The plastic-to-fuel plant extends the firm's core waste-conversion know-how, gained its own page in 2019, and fits its research-driven strategy, so it is likely to be kept.
